prose: The rebellious orator and speech superhero Dani Katz of the Word Up Podcast joins InnerVerse for a live episode where we'll get to know her and the work she does with multidimensional coaching to take clients beyond the diction of Aries deaf-initions. How do our words program our world and help or hinder our mental connection to meaning?
ext: We get into Dani's transformative NDE, our similar spontaneous temporary enlightenment experiences, the right way to talk to normies about conspiracy, the polarity of witchcraft, words that have etymological meanings opposite to our modern definitions, and much more!
